answer: In this PoA design, identity verification uses a Wesolowski VDF requiring a fixed chain of sequential modular squarings, where each result determines the next. An attacker can copy identities, but simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize this dependent computation across GPUs: each clone pays the same wall-clock delay. Consequently, pearl, violet, and island identities encounter a strict physical time bottleneck that limits Sybil growth.
